opening.argument: The video presents MEV sandwich bots as a technical demonstration, not a quick-money opportunity. The speaker tells viewers not to click links or give out private keys, describes the coding process as something they can try themselves, and explicitly says that jumping in to make quick money is “definitely not the way.” Those warnings matter: the presentation acknowledges risk rather than promising an easy return. The description does disclose affiliate and referral links, but the supplied evidence does not show a deceptive promise or an instruction to surrender funds or account control. Taken together, the demonstration and its cautions support an educational purpose.
